contract: One CREATE ONLY scheduled production_run with batch_count=1 after two prior scheduled runs; four distinct stock accounts, two managed inputs, two managed outputs. The existing source oracle runs before and after. A batch_count=200 capacity rejection then must leave the complete snapshot unchanged.

measurementProbeForSample1.note: Sample 1 preceded output-metadata-only corrections. The counter collection, parser, fixture and oracle were identical to samples 2 and 3.

metricCapture.baseline: After fixture setup and source oracle, immediately before the target CREATE.
metricCapture.after: Immediately after the successful target CREATE, before readback or snapshot queries.
metricCapture.scope: These metrics have no namespace/database labels. Deltas are process-wide and can include unrelated server work.

correctness.sourceAndRootOracles: Passed before and after each successful target CREATE.
correctness.rollback: All three rejected-write snapshots were unchanged.
correctness.reproducibility: All three fresh-process samples produced identical transaction-layer deltas: 151 keys, 9,555 key bytes, and 576,072 value bytes. Baseline values differed slightly, but observed deltas did not.

implementationNotes: Two early full-fixture attempts stopped during baseline parsing before the target CREATE. They are not measurement samples. A minimal disposable metrics-shape probe identified the 3.2.0 Prometheus byte-counter suffix and the otel_scope_name label; the parser was corrected before the three captured samples.
The original six timing samples from 2026-09-30 were not repeated.
limits: One fixed H8 profile and three serial fresh-process samples; not representative capacity or throughput certification.
Transaction-layer KV counters are not physical device writes, persisted disk bytes, compaction, or write amplification.
The metrics are process-wide; unrelated background work could contribute. No ambient counter changes altered the observed deltas in these three samples.
Dependency visits, concurrent contention variance, and physical storage behavior remain unmeasured.
